summary.en: CSL's investigational portfolio centers on blood disorders, immune proteins, renal disease and influenza vaccines. Clazakizumab and the VarmX collaboration are key novel Phase 3 programs; much of the broader display covers existing products.
summary.zh: CSL 的在研组合集中于血液疾病、免疫蛋白、肾脏疾病及流感疫苗。Clazakizumab 和 VarmX 合作项目是新药 III 期重点，官网展示的其他项目较多涉及已上市产品。

watch.en: VMX-C001 entered Phase 3; CSL funds development and holds an acquisition option on VarmX.
watch.zh: VMX-C001 已进入 III 期；CSL 提供研发资金并持有 VarmX 收购选择权。

watch.en: CSL licensed clazakizumab's additional indications to Lilly while retaining its ESKD cardiovascular program.
watch.zh: CSL 将 clazakizumab 的其他适应症许可给 Lilly，保留终末期肾病心血管项目。

watch.en: Velphoro's U.S. TDAPA reimbursement period ends in December 2026.
watch.zh: Velphoro 的美国 TDAPA 额外报销期将于 2026 年 12 月结束。

watch.en: FY2026 included $7.1 billion in impairment and related charges, alongside restructuring.
watch.zh: 2026 财年计提了 71 亿美元减值及相关费用，同时推进重组。

sources: FY2026 statutory accounts and annual report
gaps: Counts is null: a complete company-published numerical count by phase was not verified; phase-column entries were not counted.
The current pipeline is dated July 31, 2026, rather than November. Next catalysts and company-stated future dates were not verified for these eight assets; next is null throughout.
Origin was not verified for CSL787, anumigilimab, hemopexin, vamifeport and CSL404, so those origins are null. Separate development codes/generic names beyond the displayed names were not verified.
CSL301 and VMX-C001 are explicitly starred co-development projects; partner-owned assets carry option rights and are not presented as fully owned acquisitions.
The 2020 Vitaeris source predates 2026-06 and is used only for clazakizumab provenance; current phase/indication comes from the July 2026 pipeline.

Registration/Post Registration combines filed and already marketed products. Those entries and approved-product Phase 3 extensions without a verified major new-indication filing were excluded; Horizon 2 is a manufacturing yield initiative rather than a drug asset.
Plasma proteins and modified factor X are mapped to other under the required modality vocabulary.
